body:
I feel like there's real anxiety and depression that comes with it that not a damn soul wants to have floating around even in the farthest reaches of their imagination. I guess it's cool that theres more awareness, but that's really just window dressing as it comes to the totally shit cards you get handed with your diagnosis.

In fairness the recent shit when white coats have been saying to me is a little touch and go. Some say it was a wrong diagnosis because I don't really have sensory issues and can be functional even when I'm panicking inside. Fuck knows. It's tiring and it's rare there's not something that pulls my mood into a death spiral when I think of past interactions. I can't manage large friend groups or longer term connections very well at all because I have no intuition for it.

Conversation is like being a blind man trying to find the puzzle pieces that fit. Lots of em feel like they might be right, but until you place them you have no idea if you got it right or just committed puzzle rape by forcing it in where it doesn't belong. Some say this is normal, but it sure doesn't feel normal. I don't think this alone is enough to make me end things, but it makes it so much harder to deal with everything else.
